blocks.heading: B.tech CS or Allied
rows: B.Tech (CS or allied) at IIT or NIT
Government fee; entry needs JEE. JoSAA lists 67,323 seats.
NIRF 2025 submissions: median Rs 14.35 to 19.08 lakh for placed students at IIT Madras, IIT Delhi and NIT Trichy, but only about 75 to 77% of the class was placed.
Highest reliable ceiling, and the batch test still applies.
B.Tech at an average private college
Andhra Pradesh convener fee Rs 40,000 to 1,05,000 a year under the December 2025 government order (block 2023-24 to 2025-26); more under management quota.
Sathyabama (NIRF rank 67) placed 1,502 of 2,801 graduates at a median of Rs 6 lakh. Payscale entry pay for software engineers is Rs 5.37 lakh (4,950 profiles).
Cheap to enter, wide spread. Outcome depends on your skills, not the brochure.
ICAI fees about Rs 72,800; coaching Rs 3 to 4 lakh. Articleship stipend is small.
About 4.5 to 5 years, with a paid 3-year articleship

ICAI reports average domestic offers of Rs 12 to 13 lakh at its May 2026 campus placement (5,834 candidates, 8,911 vacancies). AmbitionBox shows Rs 7.6 lakh for under 3 years of experience (13,100 salaries, updated Oct 2024).
Low money cost, high time and pass-rate risk.
Andhra Pradesh government seats about Rs 15,000 a year; management quota Rs 13.2 lakh a year, about Rs 72.6 lakh in total (from a state fee summary, so confirm on the university notice).
5.5 years, then postgraduate seats for specialist pay

About 14.6 NEET candidates appeared for each MBBS seat in 2026 (20 lakh appeared, 1,36,939 seats on the NMC matrix of 22 July 2026; a September revision reports 1,40,664). No public median exists for first-job doctor pay.
A high ceiling only after a second selection filter. A private seat needs years of pay to recover.
CLAT entry requirement: 72,631 appeared in 2026 for roughly 3,600 to 3,700 seats.
NIRF 2026 data as compiled by Careers360: NLSIU placed 83 of 91 at a Rs 19 lakh median, while DNLU placed 30 of 115 at Rs 4.5 lakh.
The college changes the outcome more than the degree name does.
No tuition; training stipend reported at Rs 56,100 a month.
Level 10 entry basic Rs 56,100. With 60% dearness allowance and Rs 15,500 military service pay, about Rs 1.05 lakh a month before other allowances (our arithmetic).
Best floor of any path here, with a narrow entry requirement and age limits.

blocks.heading: Salary Myths Against the Data
rows: The highest package is what the college pays.
It is the top one offer. The median of placed students is the better number, and even that covers only the placed share.
A tier-1 name guarantees a high salary.
IIT Delhi reported 186 of 946 graduates in the neither column in 2023-24, and NIT Patna's median fell from Rs 9.88 lakh to Rs 7.0 lakh in a year.
It is a long-runway course. A private seat can cost about Rs 72.6 lakh, and pay rises sharply only after postgraduate training.
Government jobs pay less than private jobs.
At entry they often pay more. Level 6 comes to Rs 56,640 a month with 60% DA. The trade-off is 193 applicants per post and a capped ceiling.
ICAI reports Rs 12 to 13 lakh as the average domestic offer. Figures above Rs 50 lakh are overseas offers for select profiles.
Sources quote anything from Rs 18 lakh to Rs 1.3 crore. Ask what is included: type rating, overseas stay and living costs.

blocks.heading: Keep the Fee Below the Whole Budget

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: If the family's complete budget is Rs 10 lakh, that means about Rs 1 lakh for college and Rs 9 lakh for living security, a laptop, internet, books, projects, certifications and later upskilling. Treat spending above roughly 20% as a serious caution that needs course-specific proof. Both numbers are planning simple rules, not universal facts.
